description: Propose a day or week menu (up to 14 days) from the user's saved and shared recipes, preferring quick ones on busy days. Read-only: saves nothing. Show it by day, let the user swap dishes, then save with manage_menu action=save. Returns {proposal:{type, title, entries}}.

exclude_recipe_ids.description: Recipe ids to leave out (e.g. ones the user rejected)

servings.description: Servings per meal; default each recipe's own

name: plan_menu
title: Plan a menu
